items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: "He laughed about that quite often. He said, 'Many, how you doing with your nudist camps?'"

ctx.x: He laughed about that quite often. He said, "Many, how you doing with your nudist camps?" No, I can't get any work done this way. But as I was saying, I was just getting established here and -- which I think was a wise move. I came back home.
